assets.description: A woman nurse with short dark wavy hair and apricot scrubs, holding a conspicuous rolled cream bandage and a small orderly dressing tray. Bust to waist, professionally and warmly depicted. Tight vignette.

A friendly adult man bus driver wearing a teal jacket, both hands clearly gripping a large circular steering wheel, a small cream dashboard in the same vignette. Waist-up, no car surrounding the cell.

A friendly adult man community police officer in a simple navy peaked cap and teal uniform vest, with a large open stop hand and a small orange crossing paddle. No readable insignia, weapon, or logos. Bust to waist.

A friendly woman doctor with short dark hair and round glasses, a white coat and large clearly readable dark stethoscope, holding it near a small examination chart with no text. Waist-up, no background.

A friendly adult man doctor in the same style of white coat, the same large dark stethoscope and plain examination chart. Short dark hair and warm expression. Waist-up. Distinct person but same profession as cell 4.

A six-year-old schoolgirl with a short dark bob, green cardigan and a large orange school backpack clearly visible at her side, holding a cream school notebook with no writing. Compact waist-up vignette.

A friendly illustrated family postcard showing the same woman with short wavy dark hair and apricot top, the same man with dark hair and teal jacket, and their six-year-old schoolgirl with short bob and orange backpack, all together leaning toward an open empty scrapbook. One cohesive compact scene, no text and no loose objects outside it.
One orange and pale cream miniature toy van facing right with simple slate wheels and no logos. Straight side view, strong simple silhouette, no shadow.
One apricot and pale mint toy bubble boat seen from above, with a very clear small circular bubble nozzle at its right end. Face right, no water, no bubbles outside the boat, bold simple silhouette.
